t1.name: Dilnoza Rahimova
t1.quote: Real mode feels exactly like the exam. Nothing surprised me on exam day — I got B2 on my first attempt.

t2.name: Jasur Aliyev
t2.quote: The AI feedback on Writing is precise. Now I understand why every mistake is a mistake.

t3.name: Malika Yusupova
t3.quote: 30 minutes a day and drills from my plan. I went from 44 to 59 points in two months.

t4.name: Sardor Toshmatov
t4.quote: The Speaking transcript showed me my pauses. I speak much more freely now.

t5.name: Nilufar Karimova
t5.quote: Listening audio plays only once — that habit really paid off in the exam.

t6.name: Bekzod Nazarov
t6.quote: The result review pinpointed my weak spot. I worked on grammar and reached C1.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.help: Didn't find an answer? <link>Message us on Telegram</link>

format.q: How close are the tests to the official exam?
format.a: Format, timing and question types match the official CEFR Multilevel format of September 2026. Scores use the 0–75 scale and are converted to a level.

accuracy.q: How accurate is the AI score?
accuracy.a: The AI scores against the official criteria and every score comes with an explanation.

free.a: One full mock test, drills for every section and a result review. No card required.

offline.q: Will I lose my answers if the internet drops?
offline.a: No. Every answer is saved on your device instantly and sent once the connection is back.

review.title: Detailed review
review.explanationText: The speaker first gives the full price, then adds the student discount. The distractor is the first number mentioned. In questions like this, focus on what comes after words such as "but", "however" or "for students".

notes.peoplePlural: "people" is plural — the verb takes no -s.
notes.strongerAdjective: A stronger adjective — raises your Lexical score.

feedback.fillers: Cut down on "um" and "uh" — start with "Well, …".
